title: Shopify Products Data Scraper – Full Catalog, Shopify CSV
description: Extract every product from any Shopify store or collection: prices, variants, SKUs, barcodes, inventory counts, availability, images, tags. Filter by price, sale status, brand, type or stock. Or set watchLabel to buy only the diff: price drops, restocks, new, delisted. No browser. Pay per product.
seoTitle: Shopify Products Scraper – Store Catalog to JSON/CSV
seoDescription: Scrape any Shopify store's product catalog to JSON/CSV: titles, prices, variants, SKUs, barcodes and stock counts. Or watch a store and pay only for price drops, restocks and delisted products.

result.eventDescription: One product returned to the dataset.

productDetail.eventDescription: Extra fetch of the product's live page and per-product JSON for barcodes, inventory counts, seoTitle, seoDescription, ratingValue and reviewCount. Only charged when detailLevel is "full".
